ai.platforms.hf_malware_hosting.name: Malware URLs on huggingface.co
ai.platforms.hf_malware_hosting.plain: Counts reported malicious URLs hosted on Hugging Face.

ai.platforms.hf_new_models_rate.name: New models on Hugging Face per hour
ai.platforms.hf_new_models_rate.plain: How many new AI models are uploaded to Hugging Face per hour; a flood of uploads can point to mass abuse of the platform.

ai.supply_chain.osv_malware_ai.name: Malicious package reports related to AI (GHSA)
ai.supply_chain.osv_malware_ai.plain: Counts reported malicious packages whose names target AI tools (LLM, OpenAI, MCP, agent and similar).

ai.supply_chain.pypi_ai_name_typosquats.name: New PyPI names close to AI libraries
ai.supply_chain.pypi_ai_name_typosquats.plain: How many new package names per hour closely resemble a well-known AI package (openai, langchain, litellm, transformers ...).

ai.supply_chain.pypi_ai_release_burst.name: Release burst in an AI package
ai.supply_chain.pypi_ai_release_burst.plain: How many versions the most frequently updated of eight key AI packages publishes in one day; a flood can indicate a hijacked account.

ai.supply_chain.ai_exposed_servers.name: Openly reachable LLM servers on the internet
ai.supply_chain.ai_exposed_servers.plain: Counts model servers (Ollama, vLLM, Jupyter with AI) that can be reached from the internet without a login.

ai.supply_chain.cve_ai_keywords.name: New CVEs for AI frameworks (NVD)
ai.supply_chain.cve_ai_keywords.plain: Counts new vulnerability entries (CVEs, public security-flaw records) whose description mentions AI software (LangChain, Ollama, vLLM, Langflow, MLflow, ComfyUI, MCP).

ai.supply_chain.mcp_repo_growth.name: New repositories for MCP servers
ai.supply_chain.mcp_repo_growth.plain: Counts new GitHub repositories per week tagged mcp-server, as a measure of the attack surface of AI agents.

ai.supply_chain.pypi_new_projects_rate.name: New PyPI projects per hour
ai.supply_chain.pypi_new_projects_rate.plain: How many new package names are created on PyPI (the Python package index) per hour; waves occur during mass registrations.

ai.supply_chain.pypi_serial_rate.name: PyPI releases per hour (total)
ai.supply_chain.pypi_serial_rate.plain: How many new package versions appear on PyPI per hour; a jump can point to automatically spread releases.

ai.agents.ai_crawler_share.name: Share of AI crawlers in web traffic
ai.agents.ai_crawler_share.plain: Share of Cloudflare traffic that comes from AI crawlers.

ai.agents.greynoise_ai_tags.name: GreyNoise tags for AI services
ai.agents.greynoise_ai_tags.plain: Counts source IP addresses tagged as targeting AI services (for example scanning for Ollama or OpenAI keys) in a sensor network.

ai.agents.github_agent_pr_rate.name: Pull requests opened by coding agents per day
ai.agents.github_agent_pr_rate.plain: Counts pull requests per day that agent apps (Copilot Coding Agent, Devin) opened themselves.

ai.agents.ai_crawl_to_refer.name: Crawl-to-referral ratio
ai.agents.ai_crawl_to_refer.plain: Ratio of page requests by AI crawlers to visitors referred back by AI services.

ai.agents.github_agent_coauthor_commits.name: Commits with an AI co-author line
ai.agents.github_agent_coauthor_commits.plain: Counts public commits per day with a co-author line from Claude or Copilot.

ai.agents.agent_ddos_layer7.name: Layer 7 attacks as a companion measure
ai.agents.agent_ddos_layer7.plain: Total application-layer attacks, where automated attacks accumulate.

ai.agents.bot_traffic_share_total.name: Overall bot share of web traffic
ai.agents.bot_traffic_share_total.plain: Share of automated requests in all traffic.

ai.compute.gpu_rental_price.name: GPU rental prices (H100)
ai.compute.gpu_rental_price.plain: Hourly rental price for an H100 on the open market.

ai.compute.gpu_marketplace_availability.name: GPUs available on the marketplace
ai.compute.gpu_marketplace_availability.plain: Number of rented and free GPUs by type.

ai.compute.datacenter_load_pjm.name: Power load Virginia/PJM
ai.compute.datacenter_load_pjm.plain: Hourly load in the region with the most data centers.

ai.compute.ai_traffic_domain_rank.name: Domain ranking of AI services (Cloudflare Radar)
ai.compute.ai_traffic_domain_rank.plain: Rank of chatgpt.com, claude.ai and gemini.google.com in the domain ranking.

ai.markets.ai_stock_volume.name: Relative trading volume of AI chip stocks (NVDA, AMD, AVGO)
ai.markets.ai_stock_volume.plain: How heavily the shares of the leading AI chip makers are currently traded compared with the previous 10 trading days.

ai.attention.ai_local_community_activity.name: Community activity around local models
ai.attention.ai_local_community_activity.plain: Number of members and active users in r/LocalLLaMA.

bio.wastewater.amelag_sars2.name: Germany wastewater: coronavirus viral load
bio.wastewater.amelag_sars2.plain: How much coronavirus genetic material do sewage treatment plants measure nationwide in the week? The raw series fluctuates with the season.

bio.wastewater.amelag_flu.name: Germany wastewater: influenza A
bio.wastewater.amelag_flu.plain: How much influenza A genetic material do sewage treatment plants measure nationwide in the week? The raw series fluctuates with the season.

bio.wastewater.amelag_rsv.name: Germany wastewater: RSV
bio.wastewater.amelag_rsv.plain: How much RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) genetic material do sewage treatment plants measure nationwide in the week? The raw series fluctuates with the season.

bio.wastewater.amelag_flub.name: Germany wastewater: influenza B
bio.wastewater.amelag_flub.plain: How much influenza B genetic material do sewage treatment plants measure nationwide in the week? The raw series fluctuates with the season.

bio.clinical.sari_unexplained.name: Severe respiratory infections not caused by coronavirus, flu or RSV
bio.clinical.sari_unexplained.plain: What share of severe respiratory infections in hospital cannot be attributed to coronavirus, flu or RSV? This is the remainder after the three monitored pathogens; the raw series fluctuates with the season.

bio.clinical.sari_total.name: Severe respiratory infections in hospital (SARI)
bio.clinical.sari_total.plain: How many people per 100,000 are admitted to hospital with a severe respiratory infection each week? The raw series fluctuates strongly with the season.

bio.clinical.are_konsultation.name: Doctor visits for respiratory infections
bio.clinical.are_konsultation.plain: How many people per 100,000 see a doctor for an acute respiratory illness each week? The raw series fluctuates strongly with the season.

bio.clinical.are_bl_spread.name: Respiratory infections: number of states above the prior-year average
bio.clinical.are_bl_spread.plain: In how many of Germany's 16 federal states are doctor visits for respiratory infections above the average for the same calendar weeks of previous years?

bio.clinical.icu_picu.name: Children's intensive care beds occupied (PICU)
bio.clinical.icu_picu.plain: What percentage of children's intensive care beds are occupied? High values occur in the RSV season in winter.

bio.clinical.are_kids.name: Doctor visits, young children aged 0 to 4
bio.clinical.are_kids.plain: How many children under 5 per 100,000 see a doctor for a respiratory illness each week? The raw series fluctuates strongly with the season.

bio.clinical.cdc_fluview.name: USA: FluView ILINet and laboratory positivity rate
bio.clinical.cdc_fluview.plain: How common are influenza-like illnesses in the USA?

bio.clinical.icu_covid_current.name: Intensive care units: current coronavirus patients
bio.clinical.icu_covid_current.plain: How many coronavirus patients are currently in intensive care units in Germany?

bio.clinical.icu_free_vent.name: Intensive care units: free ventilator beds
bio.clinical.icu_free_vent.plain: How many ventilator beds in intensive care units in Germany are still free? If the number falls sharply, capacity becomes tight.

bio.clinical.sari_kids.name: Severe respiratory infections in young children (aged 0 to 4)
bio.clinical.sari_kids.plain: How many children under 5 per 100,000 are admitted to hospital with a severe respiratory infection each week? The raw series fluctuates strongly with the season.

bio.genomic.gisaid_counts.name: GISAID sequence counts
bio.genomic.gisaid_counts.plain: How many virus genome sequences do countries upload?

bio.markets.poultry_stocks.name: US egg price (per dozen, BLS)
bio.markets.poultry_stocks.plain: Average US store price for a dozen eggs; it rises sharply when bird flu kills many laying hens.

bio.attention.grippeweb_ili.name: GrippeWeb: self-reported influenza-like illness
bio.attention.grippeweb_ili.plain: How many people per 100,000 report fever with a cough or sore throat to the RKI (Germany's public health institute) portal GrippeWeb each week? The raw series fluctuates strongly with the season.

bio.context.amelag_covered_pop.name: Wastewater: share of the population monitored
bio.context.amelag_covered_pop.plain: What percentage of the population lives in the catchment area of the measuring sites? If the share falls, the wastewater signals are less meaningful.

blackout.grid.frequency_de_deviation.name: Germany grid frequency: deviation from 50 Hz (hourly maximum)
blackout.grid.frequency_de_deviation.plain: The grid frequency is supposed to stay at 50 Hz; large deviations show that generation and consumption are getting out of balance.

blackout.grid.balancing_energy_activatio.name: Balancing energy activation, Germany
blackout.grid.balancing_energy_activatio.plain: How much balancing power must grid operators call on at short notice?

blackout.grid.net_load_de.name: Grid load Germany (SMARD)
blackout.grid.net_load_de.plain: How much electricity Germany is using right now; a sudden drop without a public holiday or weather explanation can indicate an outage.

blackout.grid.wind_solar_infeed_de.name: Wind and solar feed-in, Germany
blackout.grid.wind_solar_infeed_de.plain: How much electricity wind and sun are currently delivering into the German grid; a drop during high demand is the pattern of a Dunkelflaute (a spell of little wind and sun).

blackout.gas.storage_fill_de.name: Gas storage Germany: fill level (daily series, about 1 week delay)
blackout.gas.storage_fill_de.plain: How full Germany's gas storage is; an unusually fast drop shows that more gas is needed than is arriving.

blackout.gas.storage_withdrawal_rate.name: Gas storage Germany: net withdrawal (daily series, about 1 week delay)
blackout.gas.storage_withdrawal_rate.plain: How much gas is taken out of German storage per day on balance; a jump upward means consumption or supply failures exceed deliveries.

blackout.gas.lng_terminal_sendout.name: LNG send-out, EU
blackout.gas.lng_terminal_sendout.plain: How much gas European LNG (liquefied natural gas) terminals feed into the grid per day.

blackout.gas.lng_inventory_eu.name: LNG tank fill level at EU terminals
blackout.gas.lng_inventory_eu.plain: How full are the LNG tanks at European terminals?

blackout.gas.storage_by_site_critical.name: Fill level of individual large storage sites
blackout.gas.storage_by_site_critical.plain: Fill level of the Rehden gas storage site (SEFE Storage, EIC 21Z000000000271O), Germany's largest.

blackout.prices.imbalance_price_rebap.name: Imbalance price reBAP
blackout.prices.imbalance_price_rebap.plain: What does a shortfall or surplus of electricity in a balancing group cost?

blackout.prices.day_ahead_de.name: Electricity price day-ahead Germany (daily average)
blackout.prices.day_ahead_de.plain: What electricity for the next day costs on average on the exchange; price spikes indicate scarcity.

blackout.prices.intraday_price_index.name: Intraday price index (ID1/ID3)
blackout.prices.intraday_price_index.plain: The price for short-term trading on the same day.

blackout.weather.cold_wave_temperature.name: Cold in Germany (daily minimum, average of Berlin, Frankfurt, Munich)
blackout.weather.cold_wave_temperature.plain: How cold the nights in Germany are; lasting frost drives heating load and electricity demand and worsens any shortage.

blackout.weather.geomagnetic_storm.name: Solar storm: geomagnetic activity (Kp index)
blackout.weather.geomagnetic_storm.plain: How strongly solar storms are currently disturbing Earth's magnetic field; in rare cases strong storms can strain high-voltage grids.

blackout.plants.entsoe_unavailability_ge.name: Unplanned power plant outages (ENTSO-E)
blackout.plants.entsoe_unavailability_ge.plain: Which power plants report outages or reduced output?

blackout.outages.cloudflare_radar_outage.name: Outage Center with power-outage causes (Cloudflare Radar)
blackout.outages.cloudflare_radar_outage.plain: Cloudflare lists internet outages with their cause, including power outages.

blackout.outages.ioda_country_internet.name: IODA: German networks in routing (effect of power outages)
blackout.outages.ioda_country_internet.plain: How many German network blocks are visible on the internet; if the value collapses, a large-scale power outage may be behind it.

blackout.outages.us_outage_counts_eaglei.name: US power outage counters (EAGLE-I, PowerOutage.us)
blackout.outages.us_outage_counts_eaglei.plain: Millions of affected customers, as a reference for the pattern.

blackout.markets.brent_oil.name: Brent crude oil price (daily series, about 1 week delay)
blackout.markets.brent_oil.plain: The price of North Sea crude oil with a delay of about a week; if it rises sharply, energy and heating oil generally become more expensive.

blackout.markets.henry_hub_gas.name: Henry Hub natural gas price (USA, daily series, about 1 week delay)
blackout.markets.henry_hub_gas.plain: The US gas price with a delay of about a week, as a comparison with the European gas price; a gap shows how scarce liquefied gas is for Europe.

cyber.routing.country_prefix_visibility_.name: Visibility of German networks in routing
cyber.routing.country_prefix_visibility_.plain: How many network blocks from Germany the RIPE measurement network sees in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing.

cyber.routing.asn_visibility_critical_de.name: Visibility of critical German ASNs
cyber.routing.asn_visibility_critical_de.plain: Share of measurement points that see major German networks (Telekom, Vodafone, DE-CIX, Hetzner, IONOS) in routing; average across five networks. An ASN is a network's identification number on the internet.

cyber.routing.hijack_events.name: BGP hijack events (suspicious MOAS)
cyber.routing.hijack_events.plain: How many suspicious cases per hour are detected in which one network claims address ranges (prefixes) that belong to another. BGP is the system that routes traffic between networks; MOAS means multiple origin networks for one address range.

cyber.dns_core.servfail_rate.name: SERVFAIL rate (resolvers)
cyber.dns_core.servfail_rate.plain: Share of DNS requests (internet address lookups) that the resolver cannot answer.

cyber.dns_core.dnssec_failures.name: DNSSEC validation failures
cyber.dns_core.dnssec_failures.plain: How often DNS answers fail because of invalid signatures (DNSSEC is the security signature system for internet address lookups).

cyber.dns_core.cf_query_volume_and_nxdom.name: DNS traffic and NXDOMAIN share
cyber.dns_core.cf_query_volume_and_nxdom.plain: Cloudflare resolver statistics: total volume and share of failed lookups (NXDOMAIN means the requested name does not exist).

cyber.dns_core.top_domain_rank_volatilit.name: Ranking volatility of top domains
cyber.dns_core.top_domain_rank_volatilit.plain: Changes in the Cloudflare Radar ranking of the most visited domains.

cyber.dns_core.openintel_dns_dependency.name: DNS dependencies on large providers
cyber.dns_core.openintel_dns_dependency.plain: How many domains depend on a few DNS and mail providers.

cyber.outages.ioda_outage_events_global.name: IODA outage events worldwide
cyber.outages.ioda_outage_events_global.plain: How many country-level internet outages IODA (a measurement project run by Georgia Tech) detects automatically per day.

cyber.outages.cf_radar_outages.name: Cloudflare Radar outage reports
cyber.outages.cf_radar_outages.plain: How many new internet outages (countries, networks, cables) Cloudflare Radar records per day.

cyber.outages.ioda_country_signals_de.name: IODA: German networks in routing
cyber.outages.ioda_country_signals_de.plain: How many German network blocks (/24, small address ranges) are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing.

cyber.outages.atlas_probe_connectivity.name: RIPE Atlas probes connected in Germany
cyber.outages.atlas_probe_connectivity.plain: How many RIPE measurement devices in Germany are online right now; a sudden drop points to network or power problems.

cyber.outages.cf_http_error_rates.name: HTTP errors and bot share (Cloudflare)
cyber.outages.cf_http_error_rates.plain: Share of 5xx server errors and automated requests in the Cloudflare network.

cyber.outages.cf_traffic_de.name: Cloudflare traffic Germany
cyber.outages.cf_traffic_de.plain: How much internet traffic from Germany arrives in the Cloudflare network (index, hourly).

cyber.outages.cf_outage_cause_cable.name: Outages caused by submarine cables
cyber.outages.cf_outage_cause_cable.plain: Number of outages that Cloudflare classifies as cable damage.

cyber.outages.cf_iqi_quality.name: Cloudflare Internet Quality Index
cyber.outages.cf_iqi_quality.plain: Combined bandwidth, latency and DNS response time by country.

cyber.outages.users_de.name: Tor user estimate Germany
cyber.outages.users_de.plain: Estimated number of direct Tor connections (an anonymity network) from Germany per day; a drop points to a network outage, a rise to people working around blocks.

cyber.outages.mlab_ndt_throughput.name: M-Lab throughput and loss
cyber.outages.mlab_ndt_throughput.plain: Millions of user speed tests: median throughput and packet loss by country.

cyber.outages.mix_protocol_shift.name: Shift in traffic mix (QUIC/HTTP versions)
cyber.outages.mix_protocol_shift.plain: Shares of HTTP/3, HTTP/2 and TLS versions in total traffic.

cyber.outages.mobile_vs_desktop_shift.name: Device split in traffic
cyber.outages.mobile_vs_desktop_shift.plain: Share of mobile and desktop in traffic.

cyber.threat.wiper_reports.name: Wiper (data-destroying) malware reports
cyber.threat.wiper_reports.plain: Reports of data-destroying malware in feeds.

cyber.threat.greynoise_cve_tag_ips.name: GreyNoise scanners per CVE tag
cyber.threat.greynoise_cve_tag_ips.plain: Number of IP addresses scanning for one specific vulnerability.

cyber.threat.cloudflare_l3_attacks.name: DDoS layer 3/4 volume
cyber.threat.cloudflare_l3_attacks.plain: How strong attack traffic at the network level (layer 3/4) in the Cloudflare network is compared with the peak of recent weeks. DDoS attacks try to overwhelm a service with traffic.

cyber.threat.dshield_port_scan_spike.name: DShield sensor reports per day
cyber.threat.dshield_port_scan_spike.plain: How many connection attempts the volunteer sensors of the SANS Internet Storm Center report per day.

cyber.threat.cloudflare_l7_attacks.name: DDoS layer 7 HTTP attacks
cyber.threat.cloudflare_l7_attacks.plain: How strong attack traffic against web applications (HTTP) in the Cloudflare network is compared with the peak of recent weeks.

cyber.threat.leak_posts_daily.name: Ransomware leak posts per day
cyber.threat.leak_posts_daily.plain: How many new victims ransomware groups name on their leak sites per day (only counted, no names).

cyber.threat.osv_malware_advisories.name: New package malware advisories (GHSA)
cyber.threat.osv_malware_advisories.plain: How many malicious packages (npm, PyPI and others) are reported in the GitHub Advisory Database in one day.

cyber.threat.targets_by_country.name: DDoS targets by country/industry
cyber.threat.targets_by_country.plain: Shift in targets by country and industry.

cyber.threat.greynoise_noise_volume.name: GreyNoise total background noise
cyber.threat.greynoise_noise_volume.plain: Total number of active scanner IP addresses.

cyber.threat.shadowserver_reflectors.name: Open DDoS reflectors
cyber.threat.shadowserver_reflectors.plain: How many open services (DNS, NTP, Memcached and similar) worldwide can be used to amplify DDoS attacks.

cyber.threat.threatfox_ioc_volume.name: ThreatFox new indicators per hour
cyber.threat.threatfox_ioc_volume.plain: How many new indicators of malware infrastructure (IP, domain, hash) are reported per hour.

cyber.threat.urlhaus_volume.name: URLhaus malware URLs per hour
cyber.threat.urlhaus_volume.plain: How many new web addresses distributing malware are reported per hour.

cyber.threat.malwarebazaar_volume.name: MalwareBazaar samples per hour
cyber.threat.malwarebazaar_volume.plain: How many new malware samples are reported per hour to the research platform MalwareBazaar.

cyber.vuln.msrc_out_of_band.name: Microsoft security bulletin outside Patch Tuesday
cyber.vuln.msrc_out_of_band.plain: How often Microsoft publishes or revises its security bulletin outside the fixed Patch Tuesday (its monthly update day).

cyber.vuln.emergency_releases.name: Chrome stable releases per day
cyber.vuln.emergency_releases.plain: How often Google updates its Chrome browser; unusually many updates point to emergency patches.

cyber.vuln.kev_additions_rate.name: New additions to the CISA KEV catalog (7-day total)
cyber.vuln.kev_additions_rate.plain: How many actively exploited vulnerabilities were newly added to the list of the US agency CISA (known as KEV) in the last seven days.

cyber.vuln.epss_high_count.name: Number of CVEs with EPSS above 0.5
cyber.vuln.epss_high_count.plain: How many vulnerabilities, according to the FIRST model (EPSS), are very likely to be exploited soon.

cyber.vuln.shadowserver_exposed.name: Shadowserver exposed vulnerable hosts (DE)
cyber.vuln.shadowserver_exposed.plain: How many servers in Germany with a known security flaw are openly reachable on the internet.

cyber.vuln.kev_ransomware_flag.name: Share of new KEV entries used in ransomware (28 days)
cyber.vuln.kev_ransomware_flag.plain: What share of the recently listed exploited vulnerabilities is already used by ransomware (extortion malware).

cyber.vuln.exposed_ot_protocols.name: Exposed OT protocols
cyber.vuln.exposed_ot_protocols.plain: How many industrial control systems (Modbus, S7 and similar) worldwide are openly reachable on the internet.

cyber.vuln.metasploit_modules.name: New Metasploit exploit modules
cyber.vuln.metasploit_modules.plain: New modules in the Metasploit framework (a security testing toolkit).

cyber.vuln.nvd_critical_share.name: Share of critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9)
cyber.vuln.nvd_critical_share.plain: How high the share of very severe vulnerabilities is among new CVEs (CVSS is a severity score from 0 to 10).

cyber.vuln.shodan_exposed_service_trend.name: Exposed services (trend)
cyber.vuln.shodan_exposed_service_trend.plain: Number of open services that may be vulnerable.

cyber.vuln.vulnerable_host_decay.name: Decline of vulnerable hosts (DE, 7 days)
cyber.vuln.vulnerable_host_decay.plain: By how many the number of vulnerable servers in Germany has fallen within a week.

cyber.vuln.advisory_volume.name: GitHub advisories volume (reviewed)
cyber.vuln.advisory_volume.plain: How many new GitHub-reviewed security notices about software packages appear in one day.

cyber.vuln.github_security_issue_spike.name: Severe GitHub advisories (high/critical)
cyber.vuln.github_security_issue_spike.plain: How many new reviewed security notices with high or critical severity appear in one day.

cyber.vuln.nvd_cve_volume.name: CVE publication volume (NVD)
cyber.vuln.nvd_cve_volume.plain: How many new vulnerability entries the US database NVD publishes in one day.

cyber.vuln.cisa_ics_advisories.name: ICS advisories per week
cyber.vuln.cisa_ics_advisories.plain: How many new or revised security notices the US agency CISA publishes per week about industrial control systems (ICS).

cyber.finance.sofr_tail.name: SOFR: spread of 99th percentile minus median
cyber.finance.sofr_tail.plain: How much more the most expensive US repo (short-term secured lending) deals pay in interest compared with the normal case; it widens when money is scarce.

cyber.finance.estr_percentile_spread.name: €STR: dispersion of interest rates
cyber.finance.estr_percentile_spread.plain: How far apart interest rates in euro interbank trading are; it widens under money market stress.

cyber.finance.stablecoin_peg_deviation.name: Stablecoin deviation from the dollar peg
cyber.finance.stablecoin_peg_deviation.plain: How far the largest stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI) deviate from a price of one dollar; it grows when trust in or access to crypto payment channels is disrupted.

cyber.finance.bitcoin_network_nodes.name: Reachable Bitcoin nodes
cyber.finance.bitcoin_network_nodes.plain: How many Bitcoin computers worldwide are reachable; a drop can point to internet disruptions.

cyber.finance.fed_repo_facility_usage.name: Fed Standing Repo Facility: usage
cyber.finance.fed_repo_facility_usage.plain: How much money banks borrow from the US central bank's emergency facility; almost always close to zero, spikes show bottlenecks.

cyber.finance.banknotes_in_circulation.name: US currency in circulation (weekly average)
cyber.finance.banknotes_in_circulation.plain: How much US cash is in circulation; it rises when people hoard cash.

cyber.finance.mempool_fee_spike.name: Bitcoin: recommended fee
cyber.finance.mempool_fee_spike.plain: How much a fast Bitcoin transfer costs; it rises when many people move money at the same time.

cyber.services.sec_8k_item105_daily_coun.name: SEC 8-K Item 1.05 filings per day
cyber.services.sec_8k_item105_daily_coun.plain: Listed US companies must report material cyber incidents within four business days; the number of filings per day shows waves.
cyber.services.sec_8k_item105_daily_coun.geoLabel: US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Washington

cyber.services.statuspage_incident_rate.name: Share of providers with a major disruption
cyber.services.statuspage_incident_rate.plain: What percentage of around 44 cloud, SaaS (software as a service), payment and crypto providers are currently reporting a major or critical disruption.

cyber.services.sam_gov_justifications.name: SAM.gov justification notices (no competition)
cyber.services.sam_gov_justifications.plain: How many US agencies per day justify IT contracts awarded without competition (Justification & Approval), often a sign of urgent need.

cyber.markets.polymarket_cyber.name: Prediction market: highest "yes" probability for cyber events
cyber.markets.polymarket_cyber.plain: The highest probability that bettors on Polymarket assign to a cyberattack or major outage (only if a matching market exists).

cyber.markets.cyber_etf_volume.name: Relative trading volume of cyber ETFs (CIBR, HACK, BUG)
cyber.markets.cyber_etf_volume.plain: How heavily cybersecurity ETFs (exchange-traded funds) are currently traded compared with the previous 10 trading days.

cyber.markets.market_volume_cyber.name: Trading volume in cyber prediction markets (24 hours)
cyber.markets.market_volume_cyber.plain: How much was bet on cyberattacks and major outages in the last 24 hours.

cyber.markets.single_name_options.name: Options activity on cyber and cloud stocks
cyber.markets.single_name_options.plain: Unusually many puts and calls (bets on falling or rising prices) on individual cyber or cloud stocks.

cyber.markets.financial_stress_index.name: St. Louis Financial Stress Index
cyber.markets.financial_stress_index.plain: An index built from 18 market indicators for stress in the financial system.

cyber.markets.vix_term_structure.name: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
cyber.markets.vix_term_structure.plain: Ratio of the short-term to the three-month fear gauge; above 1 means acute fear is greater than longer-term fear.

cyber.markets.bitcoin_vs_gold_divergence.name: Bitcoin versus gold (divergence)
cyber.markets.bitcoin_vs_gold_divergence.plain: How many ounces of gold one bitcoin is worth; it falls when investors prefer gold to bitcoin.

cyber.markets.safe_haven_fx.name: Swiss franc as a safe-haven currency (USD per CHF)
cyber.markets.safe_haven_fx.plain: How many US dollars one franc costs; it rises when investors flee into the franc.

cyber.physical.frequency_deviation_de.name: Grid frequency deviation (maximum of the last 4 minutes per hour)
cyber.physical.frequency_deviation_de.plain: The grid frequency is supposed to stay at 50 Hz; the largest deviation in a 4-minute window each hour shows whether generation and consumption are getting out of balance.

cyber.physical.generation_unit_outages_e.name: Unplanned power plant outages, EU
cyber.physical.generation_unit_outages_e.plain: Number and capacity of generating units in Europe that failed unplanned.

cyber.physical.us_ground_stops.name: US airports with a ground stop
cyber.physical.us_ground_stops.plain: How many US airports are currently not allowed to let flights depart; many at once point to a nationwide system failure.

cyber.physical.us_outage_customers.name: US power outages (customers without power)
cyber.physical.us_outage_customers.plain: Total number of households without power in the USA.

cyber.physical.cancellation_rate.name: Flight cancellation rate
cyber.physical.cancellation_rate.plain: Share of cancelled flights out of the schedule.

cyber.physical.cross_border_flow_anomaly.name: Cross-border electricity flows
cyber.physical.cross_border_flow_anomaly.plain: Physical electricity flows between countries; unusual patterns show grid stress.

cyber.physical.opensky_flight_count.name: Flight movements (aggregate)
cyber.physical.opensky_flight_count.plain: Number of aircraft in the air over an area.

cyber.physical.solar_wind_feedin_sudden_.name: Wind and solar feed-in, Germany
cyber.physical.solar_wind_feedin_sudden_.plain: How much electricity wind and sun are currently delivering into the German grid; a sudden drop without a weather cause would be unusual.

cyber.physical.adsb_coverage_loss.name: ADS-B coverage loss
cyber.physical.adsb_coverage_loss.plain: Share of visible aircraft compared with scheduled flights (ADS-B is the signal aircraft broadcast to report their position).

cyber.physical.grid_load_germany.name: Grid load Germany (SMARD)
cyber.physical.grid_load_germany.plain: How much electricity Germany is using right now; a sudden drop without a public holiday or weather explanation would be unusual.

cyber.physical.us_demand_balancing_autho.name: US electricity demand, total (Lower 48)
cyber.physical.us_demand_balancing_autho.plain: Hourly electricity consumption of the USA excluding Alaska and Hawaii; a sudden drop can point to large-scale outages.

cyber.physical.ais_position_jumps.name: AIS position jumps
cyber.physical.ais_position_jumps.plain: How many ships in a sample jump implausibly far (a sign of GPS jamming or spoofing). AIS is the position signal ships broadcast.

cyber.physical.lng_sendout_anomaly.name: LNG send-out Germany
cyber.physical.lng_sendout_anomaly.plain: How much gas German LNG (liquefied natural gas) terminals feed into the grid per day.

cyber.physical.storage_level_anomaly_eu.name: EU gas storage: net withdrawal
cyber.physical.storage_level_anomaly_eu.plain: How much gas EU storage sites release per day on balance; a sudden rise can point to supply stress.

cyber.physical.notam_gps_interference.name: NOTAMs on GPS outages
cyber.physical.notam_gps_interference.plain: Number of currently valid aviation warnings about disrupted GPS in the USA (NOTAMs are notices to pilots).

cyber.physical.port_congestion.name: Port congestion
cyber.physical.port_congestion.plain: How many ships are anchored waiting to enter off Rotterdam and the Elbe (sample).

cyber.physical.satellite_decay_events.name: Satellite decay and anomalies
cyber.physical.satellite_decay_events.plain: How many satellites and rocket parts re-entered the atmosphere the previous day, according to official reports.

cyber.attention.crowd_outage_aggregators.name: Crowd-sourced outage reports (Downdetector substitute)
cyber.attention.crowd_outage_aggregators.plain: How many users report disruptions at the same time.

cyber.attention.mobile_outage_crowd.name: Mobile network outage reports
cyber.attention.mobile_outage_crowd.plain: Crowd-sourced reports of mobile network outages.

cyber.attention.reddit_sysadmin_activity.name: Reddit r/sysadmin activity
cyber.attention.reddit_sysadmin_activity.plain: Active users in the system administrator community.

cyber.attention.hackernews_volume.name: Hacker News stories on outages and cyberattacks
cyber.attention.hackernews_volume.plain: How many new Hacker News posts per day have terms such as outage, ransomware or breach in the title.

cyber.attention.bluesky_mastodon_keyword.name: Mastodon use of cyber hashtags
cyber.attention.bluesky_mastodon_keyword.plain: How often per day the hashtags infosec, cybersecurity, ransomware and outage are used on Mastodon.

cyber.attention.eu_outage_reports_crowd.name: Crowd-sourced power outage reports, Germany
cyber.attention.eu_outage_reports_crowd.plain: Number of user reports of power outages.

cyber.attention.gdelt_cyber_volume.name: Media volume on cyberattacks (GDELT, English)
cyber.attention.gdelt_cyber_volume.plain: What share of English-language news articles worldwide is about cyberattacks, ransomware or data leaks.

cyber.attention.cloudflare_domain_rankin.name: Cloudflare Radar domain rankings of emergency and government sites
cyber.attention.cloudflare_domain_rankin.plain: Rank of government and emergency domains.

cyber.attention.gsmr_outage.name: Railway radio disruptions
cyber.attention.gsmr_outage.plain: Reports of GSM-R (railway radio) and signal box outages.

cyber.attention.vt_malware_stats.name: VirusTotal submission statistics
cyber.attention.vt_malware_stats.plain: Aggregate daily statistics of malware submissions.

cyber.attention.domain_registrations_cri.name: Newly registered domains with crisis terms
cyber.attention.domain_registrations_cri.plain: New domains with terms such as "notstrom" (emergency power) or "cyberangriff" (cyberattack).

cyber.attention.fuel_station_outage.name: Filling station outages
cyber.attention.fuel_station_outage.plain: Reports of filling stations that are closed or cannot accept payments.

cyber.attention.metaculus_manifold.name: Metaculus: new questions on cyberattacks
cyber.attention.metaculus_manifold.plain: How many new forecasting questions about cyberattacks the Metaculus community opens per day.

cyber.attention.security_repo_commit_hou.name: Commit time patterns in public security repositories
cyber.attention.security_repo_commit_hou.plain: How many commits per hour land in OpenSSL, curl and OpenSSH; unusual night work can point to an emergency.

cyber.attention.incident_response_postin.name: Incident response job postings
cyber.attention.incident_response_postin.plain: Open positions for emergency response teams.

cyber.attention.ship_ais_aggregate.name: Cable-laying ships and vessel aggregates
cyber.attention.ship_ais_aggregate.plain: How many ships are almost stationary over Baltic Sea cable routes (total count only, no individual ships).

finance.money_market.fed_discount_window.name: Fed discount window: loans
finance.money_market.fed_discount_window.plain: How much banks in distress borrow directly from the Fed (the US central bank).

finance.money_market.fed_btfp_other_cred.name: Fed: other credit to institutions
finance.money_market.fed_btfp_other_cred.plain: Shows special emergency programs and rescue loans from the Fed.

finance.money_market.sofr_tail.name: SOFR: upper spread
finance.money_market.sofr_tail.plain: How far the most expensive overnight money deals in the USA deviate from the average; stress shows up at the edge first.

finance.money_market.estr_spread.name: €STR: dispersion of interest rates
finance.money_market.estr_spread.plain: How far apart euro overnight interest rates are.

finance.money_market.us_tbill_stress.name: T-bill yields: deviation from the policy rate
finance.money_market.us_tbill_stress.plain: Gap between the 1-month US T-bill yield (short-term government debt) and the rate on central bank reserves (IORB); strongly negative means a flight to safety.

finance.money_market.us_tga_balance.name: US Treasury account at the Fed (TGA)
finance.money_market.us_tga_balance.plain: How much money the US government holds at the Fed; rapid refilling drains reserves from the market.

finance.credit.eur_ig_financial_oas.name: Euro bank bonds: spread
finance.credit.eur_ig_financial_oas.plain: Extra yield on bonds of European financial firms compared with safe bonds.

finance.credit.eur_hy_oas.name: Euro high-yield spread
finance.credit.eur_hy_oas.plain: How much risky euro-area companies pay extra for credit.

finance.credit.hy_oas.name: High-yield bonds: risk premium
finance.credit.hy_oas.plain: Extra yield that risky US companies pay for credit.

finance.credit.ig_oas.name: Investment-grade spread
finance.credit.ig_oas.plain: Extra yield on good-quality US corporate bonds.

finance.credit.ccc_oas.name: CCC spread (weakest borrowers)
finance.credit.ccc_oas.plain: Extra yield on bonds of the weakest companies.

finance.credit.ecb_yield_curve_spread.name: ECB yield curve: 10 years minus 3 months
finance.credit.ecb_yield_curve_spread.plain: Interest gap between long and short terms in the euro area; an inverted curve points to recession, and a sudden rise afterward often accompanies crises.

finance.credit.sloos_tightening.name: US credit survey (SLOOS): share of banks tightening standards
finance.credit.sloos_tightening.plain: Net share of US banks lending to companies more strictly (Fed survey, quarterly).

finance.credit.us_curve_10y3m.name: US yield curve 10Y minus 3M
finance.credit.us_curve_10y3m.plain: A recession measure used by the Fed.

finance.credit.us_curve_10y2y.name: US yield curve 10Y minus 2Y
finance.credit.us_curve_10y2y.plain: Gap between long-term and short-term US interest rates.

finance.banks.fdic_failed_list.name: FDIC: bank closures (last 90 days)
finance.banks.fdic_failed_list.plain: How many US banks were closed by the deposit insurer in the last 90 days; single cases are normal, a cluster is a warning sign.

finance.banks.h8_deposits.name: Fed H.8: deposits at all US banks
finance.banks.h8_deposits.plain: Weekly total of customer deposits at US banks.

finance.banks.h8_borrowings.name: Fed H.8: bank borrowings
finance.banks.h8_borrowings.plain: How much banks have to borrow themselves.

finance.volatility.fx_vol.name: Currencies: swings of the euro against the dollar, yen and franc
finance.volatility.fx_vol.plain: How strongly the euro swings against the dollar, yen and Swiss franc (safe-haven currencies) in one day; stress often shows up first in currencies.

finance.crypto.stablecoin_depeg.name: Stablecoin deviations
finance.crypto.stablecoin_depeg.plain: How far the largest stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI) deviate from the 1-dollar price; losing the peg is a sign of panic.

finance.real_economy.cre_delinq.name: Commercial real estate loans: delinquency rate
finance.real_economy.cre_delinq.plain: Defaults on office and retail property loans.

finance.real_economy.consumer_credit_del.name: Consumer credit delinquencies
finance.real_economy.consumer_credit_del.plain: Share of overdue loans on credit cards and cars.

finance.real_economy.destatis_insolvenze.name: German regular insolvencies (early indicator)
finance.real_economy.destatis_insolvenze.plain: Monthly number of company insolvency filings in Germany.

finance.real_economy.oil_price.name: Brent oil price (daily series, about 1 week delay)
finance.real_economy.oil_price.plain: Measures the Brent oil price per barrel with a delay of about a week; an oil shock drives up inflation, interest rates and thus credit stress.

finance.markets.us_10y_yield.name: US 10-year yield
finance.markets.us_10y_yield.plain: Yield on long-term US government bonds.

nuclear.radiation.bfs_stations_above_nor.name: Monitoring stations clearly above the natural range (sample)
nuclear.radiation.bfs_stations_above_nor.plain: How many of 15 fixed German radiation monitoring stations currently measure more than 0.3 microsieverts per hour; normally none do.

nuclear.radiation.bfs_median_dose_rate.name: Average ambient dose rate, Germany (sample)
nuclear.radiation.bfs_median_dose_rate.plain: The average value of 15 fixed German radiation monitoring stations in microsieverts per hour, a very calm value.

nuclear.radiation.uradmonitor_europe.name: uRADMonitor: sensors in Europe
nuclear.radiation.uradmonitor_europe.plain: Public sensors of a private measurement network for radiation and air readings.

nuclear.seismic.events_near_punggye_ri.name: Seismic events near Punggye-ri (North Korea)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_punggye_ri.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site Punggye-ri (North Korea).

nuclear.seismic.events_near_novaya_zemly.name: Seismic events near Novaya Zemlya (Russia)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_novaya_zemly.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site Novaya Zemlya (Russia).

nuclear.seismic.events_near_lop_nur.name: Seismic events near Lop Nur (China)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_lop_nur.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site Lop Nur (China).

nuclear.seismic.events_near_nevada_nnss.name: Seismic events near Nevada (USA)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_nevada_nnss.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site in Nevada (USA).

nuclear.seismic.events_near_chagai.name: Seismic events near Chagai (Pakistan)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_chagai.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site Chagai (Pakistan).

nuclear.seismic.events_near_pokhran.name: Seismic events near Pokhran (India)
nuclear.seismic.events_near_pokhran.plain: Number of shallow earthquake or explosion reports in the last 24 hours near the known test site Pokhran (India).

nuclear.seismic.explosion_type_global_co.name: Explosions reported worldwide in the earthquake catalog
nuclear.seismic.explosion_type_global_co.plain: Number of events in the last 24 hours that seismologists classify as an explosion rather than an earthquake.

nuclear.plants.entsoe_unavailability_nuc.name: ENTSO-E: nuclear power plant unavailability
nuclear.plants.entsoe_unavailability_nuc.plain: Reported planned and unplanned outages of European nuclear power plants.

nuclear.plants.entsoe_nuclear_generation.name: ENTSO-E: generation per nuclear power plant
nuclear.plants.entsoe_nuclear_generation.plain: Output of individual units at European nuclear power plants.

nuclear.plants.fi_fingrid_nuclear.name: Finland: nuclear power (Fingrid)
nuclear.plants.fi_fingrid_nuclear.plain: How much electricity Finland's nuclear power plants are currently generating (hourly average).

nuclear.plants.entsoe_ukraine_grid.name: Ukraine: grid load flow at the border
nuclear.plants.entsoe_ukraine_grid.plain: Cross-border electricity flows from Ukraine into the EU, as a health measure of the grid.

nuclear.alerts.nina_keyword_radiological.name: Active NINA warnings with a radiation or nuclear keyword
nuclear.alerts.nina_keyword_radiological.plain: How many active warnings contain terms such as radioactive, radiation or nuclear in the title; normally zero. NINA is Germany's official emergency warning app.

nuclear.alerts.nina_mowas_count.name: Active warnings in NINA (MoWaS)
nuclear.alerts.nina_mowas_count.plain: How many official warnings in the German federal Modular Warning System are currently active; a jump shows a major situation, usually weather.

nuclear.military.faa_notam_us_closures.name: FAA: airspace closures (NOTAM)
nuclear.military.faa_notam_us_closures.plain: Number of currently valid temporary closures of US airspace (TFRs, temporary flight restrictions).

nuclear.military.adsb_mil_total.name: Military aircraft visible worldwide (nuclear view)
nuclear.military.adsb_mil_total.plain: How many military aircraft are currently visible on public flight radars; a clear rise can indicate redeployments and higher readiness.

nuclear.markets.polymarket_nuclear.name: Nuclear weapons prediction markets: highest "yes" probability
nuclear.markets.polymarket_nuclear.plain: The highest probability that bettors on Polymarket assign to a use of nuclear weapons, a nuclear test or a detonation (only if a matching market exists).

nuclear.markets.uranium_etf_urnm.name: Uranium mining ETF (URNM)
nuclear.markets.uranium_etf_urnm.plain: The price of a fund of uranium producers; it rises when higher demand for nuclear energy is expected, but can also reflect fear of crisis.

nuclear.markets.cameco_ccj.name: Cameco stock (uranium)
nuclear.markets.cameco_ccj.plain: The share price of Cameco, one of the world's largest uranium producers.

nuclear.markets.uranium_trust_sprott.name: Sprott Physical Uranium Trust
nuclear.markets.uranium_trust_sprott.plain: The price of a fund that holds physical uranium; it follows the uranium price.

nuclear.markets.defense_stocks.name: Daily swings of major defense stocks (LMT, NOC, Rheinmetall)
nuclear.markets.defense_stocks.plain: How much the shares of Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman and Rheinmetall rise or fall on average in one day.

nuclear.markets.vix_gold.name: Daily swings of the fear index (VIX) and gold
nuclear.markets.vix_gold.plain: How much the US stock market fear index and the gold price rise or fall on average in one day; both react to fear of crisis.

nuclear.markets.fred_uranium_price.name: IMF uranium price (monthly, FRED)
nuclear.markets.fred_uranium_price.plain: Global uranium price as an official monthly series.

nuclear.attention.wiki_plants_sites.name: Wikipedia views on nuclear plants and reactor accidents (English)
nuclear.attention.wiki_plants_sites.plain: How often English Wikipedia articles on the Zaporizhzhia plant, Chernobyl, Fukushima, Three Mile Island and nuclear meltdowns are viewed.

nuclear.attention.gdelt_nuclear_volume.name: Media volume on nuclear, radiation and reactor (GDELT, English)
nuclear.attention.gdelt_nuclear_volume.plain: What share of English-language news articles worldwide is about nuclear, radiation or reactors.

nuclear.attention.wiki_nuclear_de.name: Wikipedia views on nuclear war and radiation protection (German)
nuclear.attention.wiki_nuclear_de.plain: How often German-language Wikipedia articles on potassium iodide, nuclear war, radioactive fallout, radiation sickness, nuclear weapons and nuclear weapons tests are viewed.

nuclear.attention.wiki_nuclear_en.name: Wikipedia views on nuclear war and fallout (English)
nuclear.attention.wiki_nuclear_en.plain: How often English Wikipedia articles on potassium iodide, nuclear warfare, nuclear fallout, acute radiation syndrome, nuclear weapons and nuclear weapons testing are viewed.

war.military.faa_closures.name: Airspace restrictions (NOTAM) at hotspots
war.military.faa_closures.plain: Counts new airspace restrictions (NOTAMs, notices to pilots) for Kyiv, Baku, Tehran and Taipei per day.

war.military.satellite_imagery_airbases.name: Satellite images of airbases
war.military.satellite_imagery_airbases.plain: Counts aircraft at military airbases in freely available satellite images.

war.conflict.israel_oref.name: Israel: alert waves per day (rockets and drones)
war.conflict.israel_oref.plain: Counts how often per day rocket or drone alerts were triggered in Israel.

war.conflict.firms_gulf_energy.name: Heat points at Gulf energy facilities
war.conflict.firms_gulf_energy.plain: Detects by satellite fires at oil and gas facilities on the coasts of the Persian Gulf (per day).

war.conflict.ua_air_alerts.name: Ukraine: air-raid alerts per day (all regions)
war.conflict.ua_air_alerts.plain: Adds up the daily air-raid alerts in all Ukrainian regions; jumps show larger waves of missile and drone attacks.

war.conflict.firms_korea_dmz.name: Hotspots in Korea (border)
war.conflict.firms_korea_dmz.plain: Counts heat points detected by satellite near the inter-Korean border (per day).

war.conflict.fires_infrastructure.name: Satellite heat points in Iran and the Gulf
war.conflict.fires_infrastructure.plain: Counts heat points detected by satellite in Iran and around the Gulf, where refineries, ports and depots are located (per day).

war.conflict.firms_front_ukraine.name: Heat sources along the front
war.conflict.firms_front_ukraine.plain: Counts fires and heat points detected by satellite in eastern Ukraine (per day).

war.conflict.firms_refineries_russia.name: Strong fires in European Russia (refinery belt)
war.conflict.firms_refineries_russia.plain: Counts strong fires detected by satellite (from 10 MW radiative power) in European Russia, where the large refineries are located.

war.conflict.acled_events_weekly.name: ACLED: events and fatalities per week
war.conflict.acled_events_weekly.plain: Counts documented violent events per country and week.

war.conflict.ucdp_candidate.name: UCDP candidate events: fatalities by country
war.conflict.ucdp_candidate.plain: Measures provisional estimated fatalities of organized violence per country and month.

war.conflict.reliefweb_reports.name: ReliefWeb: situation reports by country and day
war.conflict.reliefweb_reports.plain: Counts humanitarian situation reports from the UN and NGOs about a country.

war.conflict.ua_losses_reported.name: Ukraine: Russian losses per day, as reported by Ukraine (a party to the war)
war.conflict.ua_losses_reported.plain: Daily number of Russian personnel losses as reported by the Ukrainian General Staff; a claim by a party to the war that cannot be independently verified, it only shows the published intensity.

war.conflict.ukraine_drone_missile_daily.name: Ukraine: drones and missiles downed per day, as reported by Ukraine
war.conflict.ukraine_drone_missile_daily.plain: Daily number of drones and cruise missiles shot down according to the Ukrainian General Staff; a claim by a party to the war that cannot be independently verified.

war.shipping.ais_gaps_gulf.name: AIS shutoffs in the Gulf region
war.shipping.ais_gaps_gulf.plain: Counts ships in the Gulf that deliberately switch off their tracking signal (per day, with a delay of a few days). AIS is the position signal ships broadcast.

war.shipping.baltic_dark_vessels.name: Dark vessels in the Baltic Sea
war.shipping.baltic_dark_vessels.plain: Counts ships in the Baltic Sea that deliberately switch off their tracking signal (per day, with a delay of a few days).

war.shipping.baltic_dry_dirty_tanker.name: Baltic Dry and tanker rates
war.shipping.baltic_dry_dirty_tanker.plain: Measures freight rates for bulk cargo and oil tankers.

war.connectivity.ioda_ir.name: IODA: Iran in routing
war.connectivity.ioda_ir.plain: How many network blocks (/24, small address ranges) from Iran are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing (power grid, attack or shutdown).

war.connectivity.ioda_tw.name: IODA: Taiwan in routing
war.connectivity.ioda_tw.plain: How many network blocks (/24, small address ranges) from Taiwan are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing (power grid, attack or shutdown).

war.connectivity.ioda_il.name: IODA: Israel in routing
war.connectivity.ioda_il.plain: How many network blocks (/24, small address ranges) from Israel are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing (power grid, attack or shutdown).

war.connectivity.ioda_ua.name: IODA: Ukraine in routing
war.connectivity.ioda_ua.plain: How many network blocks (/24, small address ranges) from Ukraine are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing (power grid, attack or shutdown).

war.connectivity.gulf_states_internet.name: IODA: Gulf states in routing (total)
war.connectivity.gulf_states_internet.plain: Total of the network blocks visible in routing from Saudi Arabia, the Emirates and Qatar; a drop points to a large-scale outage in the Gulf.

war.connectivity.ioda_ru.name: IODA: Russia in routing
war.connectivity.ioda_ru.plain: How many network blocks (/24, small address ranges) from Russia are visible in routing worldwide; a drop means networks are disappearing (power grid, attack or shutdown).

war.connectivity.power_grid_frontline.name: Electricity flows Ukraine, Baltics, Moldova (ENTSO-E)
war.connectivity.power_grid_frontline.plain: Measures cross-border electricity flows and outages near the front.

war.connectivity.traffic_by_network.name: Data traffic by country and network (mobile, data centers)
war.connectivity.traffic_by_network.plain: Measures traffic drops in countries and networks as a sign of power and network outages.

war.government.defense_procurement.name: US ammunition tenders (SAM.gov)
war.government.defense_procurement.plain: How many new US federal tenders per day concern ammunition (NAICS 332993, the industry code for ammunition manufacturing).

war.government.school_closures.name: School closures in conflict areas
war.government.school_closures.plain: Counts school closures for security reasons.

war.government.ammo_trade.name: Ammunition foreign trade
war.government.ammo_trade.plain: Measures foreign trade in ammunition according to customs statistics.

war.energy.lng_terminals.name: LNG stocks at German terminals
war.energy.lng_terminals.plain: How much LNG (liquefied natural gas, in GWh of gas equivalent) is stored in the German terminals.

war.energy.us_spr_stocks.name: US Strategic Petroleum Reserve and stocks
war.energy.us_spr_stocks.plain: Measures the stocks of the Strategic Petroleum Reserve and oil storage in the USA.

war.energy.eu_gas_storage.name: EU gas storage fill level
war.energy.eu_gas_storage.plain: Measures how full the gas storage sites in the EU are.

war.markets.brent_price.name: Brent crude oil price (daily series, about 1 week delay)
war.markets.brent_price.plain: Measures the oil price (Brent) per barrel with a delay of about a week; fear of war in producing regions and closures of sea routes push it up.

war.markets.defense_stocks_eu.name: Rheinmetall stock
war.markets.defense_stocks_eu.plain: The share price of Rheinmetall, Germany's largest defense company; it reflects expectations of orders and escalation.

war.markets.ovx.name: OVX oil volatility
war.markets.ovx.plain: Measures how strongly investors expect swings in the oil price.

war.markets.defense_etf_us.name: US defense ETF (ITA)
war.markets.defense_etf_us.plain: The price of a fund of US defense and aerospace companies; it rises when higher military spending is expected.

war.markets.wti_price.name: WTI crude oil price (daily series, about 1 week delay)
war.markets.wti_price.plain: Measures the US oil price (WTI) per barrel with a delay of about a week.

war.markets.gas_henry_vs_ttf.name: Gas spread: TTF versus Henry Hub
war.markets.gas_henry_vs_ttf.plain: Monthly gap between the European and the US gas price (IMF series); it widens when supply fears grow in Europe.

war.markets.wheat_prices.name: Wheat price
war.markets.wheat_prices.plain: The world market price of wheat; Ukraine and Russia are major exporters, and wars push the price up.

war.markets.fuel_bunker_prices.name: Jet fuel price, US Gulf Coast
war.markets.fuel_bunker_prices.plain: Wholesale price of jet fuel on the US Gulf Coast (ship fuel prices are not available on FRED).

war.markets.breakeven_inflation.name: Inflation expectations (breakeven)
war.markets.breakeven_inflation.plain: Measures what inflation the bond markets expect; an oil shock pushes it up.

war.markets.fertilizer_prices.name: Producer prices for nitrogen fertilizer (USA)
war.markets.fertilizer_prices.plain: Producer price index for nitrogen fertilizer in the USA; it rises when gas is scarce or deliveries are disrupted.

war.markets.gold_price.name: Gold price
war.markets.gold_price.plain: The gold price; investors flee into gold when they are afraid.

war.markets.gvz_and_move.name: Gold volatility (GVZ)
war.markets.gvz_and_move.plain: Measures how strongly investors expect swings in the gold price (the MOVE bond volatility index is not available on FRED).

war.markets.crypto_stablecoin_flows.name: Tether in circulation (market capitalization of USDT)
war.markets.crypto_stablecoin_flows.plain: How many Tether dollars are in circulation; sudden growth shows capital flight into stablecoins.

war.markets.safe_haven_jpy.name: Japanese yen (USD per 100 JPY)
war.markets.safe_haven_jpy.plain: How many US dollars 100 yen cost; it rises when investors flee into the yen.

war.markets.vix.name: VIX (fear index of the US stock market), war view
war.markets.vix.plain: How nervous the US stock market is overall; it rises in any kind of crisis, including fear of war.

war.markets.hy_credit_spread.name: Credit spreads on corporate bonds
war.markets.hy_credit_spread.plain: Measures the extra interest that risky companies pay; it rises with general fear.

war.markets.us_10y_yield.name: US 10-year yield
war.markets.us_10y_yield.plain: Measures the interest rate on ten-year US government bonds; a flight to safety lowers it, fear of inflation raises it.

war.attention.frontline_area_change.name: Ukraine: front line shift (change in occupied area per day)
war.attention.frontline_area_change.plain: Measures how much area is drawn as occupied from one day to the next on the volunteer map DeepStateMap; large jumps show offensives or map corrections.

war.attention.prediction_markets_war.name: War prediction markets: highest "yes" probability
war.attention.prediction_markets_war.plain: The highest probability that bettors on Polymarket assign to a world war, use of nuclear weapons, an attack or a blockade (only if a matching market exists).

war.attention.prediction_volume_spike.name: Trading volume in war prediction markets (24 hours)
war.attention.prediction_volume_spike.plain: How much was bet on war, nuclear weapons, attacks and blockades in the last 24 hours; sudden jumps stand out.

war.attention.gdelt_coverage_share.name: GDELT: share of world-war coverage in news volume
war.attention.gdelt_coverage_share.plain: What share of English-language news articles is about a world war or nuclear war.

war.attention.hackernews_mentions.name: Hacker News stories on war and escalation
war.attention.hackernews_mentions.plain: How many new Hacker News posts per day have terms such as World War, nuclear war or Hormuz in the title.

war.attention.pizza_index.name: Pizza index: delivery rush at military sites (weak idea)
war.attention.pizza_index.plain: Idea: unusually many pizza deliveries to defense sites as a hint of overtime.

cyber.physical.military_aircraft_visible.name: Military aircraft visible worldwide
cyber.physical.military_aircraft_visible.plain: How many military aircraft are currently visible on public flight radars; unusually many or suddenly very few stand out.

war.military.mil_aircraft_visible_global.name: Military aircraft visible worldwide (war view)
war.military.mil_aircraft_visible_global.plain: How many military aircraft are currently visible on public flight radars; a clear rise can indicate redeployments and higher readiness.

war.conflict.ua_active_air_raid_oblasts.name: Ukraine: regions with active air-raid alert (live)
war.conflict.ua_active_air_raid_oblasts.plain: In how many Ukrainian regions an air-raid alert is currently in force.

war.conflict.ua_active_missile_threats.name: Ukraine: regions with missile warning (live)
war.conflict.ua_active_missile_threats.plain: In how many Ukrainian regions there is currently an explicit warning about missiles or launch platforms.

cyber.outages.cf_traffic_us.name: Cloudflare traffic USA
cyber.outages.cf_traffic_us.plain: How much internet traffic from the USA arrives in the Cloudflare network (index, hourly).

cyber.routing.cf_bgp_hijacks_24h.name: BGP hijack events (24 h, Radar)
cyber.routing.cf_bgp_hijacks_24h.plain: How many suspected diversions of internet address ranges Cloudflare Radar detected in the last 24 hours.

cyber.routing.cf_route_leaks_24h.name: BGP route leaks (24 h, Radar)
cyber.routing.cf_route_leaks_24h.plain: How many misdirected routing announcements (route leaks) Cloudflare Radar detected in the last 24 hours.

cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_argon.name: Certificate issuance rate, Google Argon
cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_argon.plain: How many new certificates per hour are entered in the Google Argon transparency log (a public record of security certificates); a drop or jump points to outages at certificate authorities or mass issuance.

cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_xenon.name: Certificate issuance rate, Google Xenon
cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_xenon.plain: How many new certificates per hour are entered in the Google Xenon transparency log (a public record of security certificates); a drop or jump points to outages at certificate authorities or mass issuance.

cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_nimbus.name: Certificate issuance rate, Cloudflare Nimbus
cyber.dns_core.ct_tree_size_nimbus.plain: How many new certificates per hour are entered in the Cloudflare Nimbus transparency log (a public record of security certificates); a drop or jump points to outages at certificate authorities or mass issuance.

cyber.vuln.cve_published_daily.name: Newly published CVEs per day
cyber.vuln.cve_published_daily.plain: How many new security flaws with a CVE number are published per day; a jump shows unusual waves of reports.

cyber.vuln.cve_updated_daily.name: Updated CVEs per day
cyber.vuln.cve_updated_daily.plain: How many existing CVE entries are revised per day; jumps are mostly bulk corrections, rarely crises.

cyber.finance.estr_volume.name: €STR: trading volume
cyber.finance.estr_volume.plain: How much money banks in the euro area lend each other overnight; drops or jumps point to disruptions in the money market.

cyber.physical.frequency_stddev_de.name: Grid frequency unrest (standard deviation, 4-minute window per hour)
cyber.physical.frequency_stddev_de.plain: How strongly the grid frequency fluctuates in a 4-minute window each hour; a calm grid stays tightly around 50 Hz.

cyber.physical.us_ground_delay_programs.name: US airports with a ground delay program
cyber.physical.us_ground_delay_programs.plain: How many US airports are currently holding flights at the departure airport, usually because of weather or congestion.

cyber.physical.us_airport_closures.name: Closed US airports
cyber.physical.us_airport_closures.plain: How many US airports are currently fully closed according to the FAA (excluding partial closures for occasional traffic or night closures).

finance.money_market.sofr_volume.name: SOFR: trading volume
finance.money_market.sofr_volume.plain: How much money is turned over in the US repo market (short-term secured lending) overnight; strong deviations point to disruptions.

finance.money_market.estr_volume.name: €STR: trading volume
finance.money_market.estr_volume.plain: How much money banks in the euro area lend each other overnight; drops or jumps point to disruptions in the money market.

blackout.grid.frequency_nordic_deviation.name: Nordic grid frequency (Fingrid): largest deviation
blackout.grid.frequency_nordic_deviation.plain: The maximum by which the grid frequency in the Nordic power system deviated from 50 Hz in the last hour.

cyber.threat.firehol_blocklist_de_entrie.name: Blocklist.de: attacker IPs (48 hours)
cyber.threat.firehol_blocklist_de_entrie.plain: How many IP addresses were reported to Blocklist.de as attackers (break-in attempts on servers) in the last 48 hours.

cyber.threat.firehol_greensnow_entries.name: GreenSnow: attacker IPs
cyber.threat.firehol_greensnow_entries.plain: How many IP addresses GreenSnow currently lists as attackers (port scans, brute-force password guessing).

cyber.threat.firehol_bruteforceblocker_e.name: BruteForceBlocker: attacker IPs
cyber.threat.firehol_bruteforceblocker_e.plain: How many IP addresses were caught guessing passwords against SSH services (remote server logins).

cyber.threat.firehol_abusers_1d_entries.name: FireHOL: attackers in the last 24 hours
cyber.threat.firehol_abusers_1d_entries.plain: How many IP addresses were caught in the last 24 hours attacking web servers, mail servers and blogs (a combination of several sources).

cyber.threat.firehol_cybercrime_entries.name: CyberCrime Tracker: malware servers
cyber.threat.firehol_cybercrime_entries.plain: How many IP addresses are currently listed as control servers of malware.

cyber.threat.firehol_level2_entries.name: FireHOL Level 2: attacks in the last 48 hours
cyber.threat.firehol_level2_entries.plain: A combination of several blocklists: how many IP addresses carried out attacks in the last 48 hours.

cyber.threat.firehol_tor_exits_entries.name: Tor exit nodes (number of IPs)
cyber.threat.firehol_tor_exits_entries.plain: How many Tor exit nodes are currently on the network; a drop or jump points to interference with the Tor network.

cyber.attention.gdelt_cyber_volume_de.name: Media volume on cyberattacks (GDELT, German)
cyber.attention.gdelt_cyber_volume_de.plain: What share of German-language news articles is about cyberattacks, hacker attacks or ransomware.

war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_iran_hormuz.name: Media volume on Iran and Hormuz (GDELT, English)
war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_iran_hormuz.plain: What share of English-language news articles worldwide is about Iran or the Strait of Hormuz.

war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_ukraine_nato.name: Media volume on Ukraine and NATO's eastern flank (GDELT, English)
war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_ukraine_nato.plain: What share of English-language news articles worldwide is about Ukraine or NATO.

war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_taiwan.name: Media volume on Taiwan (GDELT, English)
war.attention.gdelt_hotspot_taiwan.plain: What share of English-language news articles worldwide is about Taiwan.

war.conflict.ua_air_alert_regions.name: Ukraine: regions with an air-raid alert per day
war.conflict.ua_air_alert_regions.plain: Counts in how many of the 24 regions at least one air-raid alert was triggered during the day; a rise shows that western regions are affected too.

war.markets.gas_henry_hub.name: Henry Hub natural gas price, USA (daily series, about 1 week delay)
war.markets.gas_henry_hub.plain: Measures the US natural gas price with a delay of about a week; a sharp rise is usually due to weather or LNG exports, and wars in producing regions pull it up too.

blackout.gas.storage_fill_eu.name: EU gas storage: fill level (daily series, about 1 week delay)
blackout.gas.storage_fill_eu.plain: How full gas storage in the EU is overall; if the level falls faster than usual, gas becomes scarcer in winter.

war.markets.brent_wti_spread.name: Price gap Brent minus WTI (daily series)
war.markets.brent_wti_spread.plain: Measures by how many dollars Brent is more expensive than WTI; the gap widens when shipping routes in the Middle East are disrupted.

ai.incidents.hackernews_ai_incidents.name: Hacker News stories on AI incidents
ai.incidents.hackernews_ai_incidents.plain: How many new Hacker News posts per day have terms such as jailbreak, prompt injection or model leak in the title.

cyber.outages.ioda_ping_de.name: IODA: reachable German networks (ping)
cyber.outages.ioda_ping_de.plain: How many German network blocks (/24, small address ranges) respond to active requests; measured independently of routing.

cyber.outages.ioda_bgp_big_countries.name: IODA: routing visibility of large countries (total)
cyber.outages.ioda_bgp_big_countries.plain: Total of the network blocks visible in routing from eight large countries; a drop points to a large-scale outage.

cyber.threat.ipsum_ips_ge3.name: IPsum: IPs on at least 3 blocklists
cyber.threat.ipsum_ips_ge3.plain: How many IP addresses appear on at least three of many public blocklists; it rises during waves of attacks and scans.

cyber.threat.ipsum_ips_ge5.name: IPsum: IPs on at least 5 blocklists
cyber.threat.ipsum_ips_ge5.plain: How many IP addresses appear on at least five blocklists, meaning they are especially certain to be malicious.

cyber.finance.mempool_size.name: Bitcoin: size of the queue
cyber.finance.mempool_size.plain: How many Bitcoin transfers are waiting for confirmation; it grows during a rush or disruptions.

cyber.vuln.msrc_cve_publications.name: New Microsoft CVE reports per day
cyber.vuln.msrc_cve_publications.plain: How many new security flaws Microsoft publishes daily in its Update Guide.

nuclear.alerts.nina_mowas_severe.name: Severe active warnings in NINA
nuclear.alerts.nina_mowas_severe.plain: How many of the active warnings are classified as severe or extreme.

cyber.context.geomagnetic_kp.name: Geomagnetic activity (Kp index)
cyber.context.geomagnetic_kp.plain: How strongly solar storms are currently disturbing Earth's magnetic field; high values naturally explain GPS, radio and satellite problems.

cyber.finance.sofr_volume.name: SOFR: trading volume
cyber.finance.sofr_volume.plain: How much money is turned over in the US repo market (short-term secured lending) overnight; strong deviations point to disruptions.

cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_de.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Germany)
cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_de.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Germany show conspicuous failures or blocking.

cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_us.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (USA)
cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_us.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in the USA show conspicuous failures or blocking.

cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_gb.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (United Kingdom)
cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_gb.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in the United Kingdom show conspicuous failures or blocking.

cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_fr.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (France)
cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_fr.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in France show conspicuous failures or blocking.

cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_nl.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Netherlands)
cyber.outages.ooni_anomaly_share_nl.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in the Netherlands show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ir.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Iran)
war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ir.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Iran show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_il.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Israel)
war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_il.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Israel show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ua.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Ukraine)
war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ua.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Ukraine show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ru.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Russia)
war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_ru.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Russia show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_tw.name: Share of anomalous web measurements (Taiwan)
war.connectivity.ooni_anomaly_share_tw.plain: What share of OONI measurements of website reachability in Taiwan show conspicuous failures or blocking.

war.conflict.israel_oref_localities.name: Israel: localities alerted per day
war.conflict.israel_oref_localities.plain: Counts in how many different localities per day rocket or drone alerts were triggered; many locations mean a broad attack.

cyber.threat.otx_wiper_pulses.name: OTX reports on wiper malware
cyber.threat.otx_wiper_pulses.plain: How many new reports about data-destroying malware (wipers) appear in the OTX community (AlienVault Open Threat Exchange).

cyber.threat.otx_ics_pulses.name: OTX reports on industrial systems (ICS/SCADA)
cyber.threat.otx_ics_pulses.plain: How many new reports about attacks on industrial control systems appear in the OTX community.

nuclear.markets.polymarket_nuclear_volum.name: Trading volume in nuclear weapons prediction markets (24 hours)
nuclear.markets.polymarket_nuclear_volum.plain: How much was bet on the use of nuclear weapons or nuclear tests in the last 24 hours; sudden jumps stand out.

cyber.threat.ransomware_active_groups.name: Active ransomware groups per day
cyber.threat.ransomware_active_groups.plain: How many different ransomware groups publish at least one new victim per day.

cyber.outages.atlas_probes_connected_glo.name: RIPE Atlas probes connected worldwide
cyber.outages.atlas_probes_connected_glo.plain: How many RIPE measurement devices worldwide are online right now; a drop points to a large-scale disruption.

bio.wastewater.amelag_sars2_saison.name: Germany wastewater: coronavirus viral load compared with previous years
bio.wastewater.amelag_sars2_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years is coronavirus genetic material in wastewater? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.wastewater.amelag_flu_saison.name: Germany wastewater: influenza A compared with previous years
bio.wastewater.amelag_flu_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years is influenza A genetic material in wastewater? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.wastewater.amelag_flub_saison.name: Germany wastewater: influenza B compared with previous years
bio.wastewater.amelag_flub_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years is influenza B genetic material in wastewater? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.wastewater.amelag_rsv_saison.name: Germany wastewater: RSV compared with previous years
bio.wastewater.amelag_rsv_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years is RSV genetic material in wastewater? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.clinical.are_konsultation_saison.name: Doctor visits for respiratory infections compared with previous years
bio.clinical.are_konsultation_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years are doctor visits for respiratory infections? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.clinical.are_kids_saison.name: Doctor visits, young children, compared with previous years
bio.clinical.are_kids_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years are doctor visits by children under 5? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.attention.grippeweb_ili_saison.name: GrippeWeb: influenza-like illness compared with previous years
bio.attention.grippeweb_ili_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years are self-reports of influenza-like illness? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.clinical.sari_total_saison.name: Severe respiratory infections in hospital compared with previous years
bio.clinical.sari_total_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years are hospital cases with a severe respiratory infection? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.clinical.sari_kids_saison.name: Severe respiratory infections, young children, vs. previous years
bio.clinical.sari_kids_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years are hospital cases of children under 5? 1 means usual for the time of year.

bio.clinical.sari_unexplained_saison.name: Severe respiratory infections of unknown cause vs. previous years
bio.clinical.sari_unexplained_saison.plain: How much higher or lower than the average of the same calendar weeks in previous years is the share of severe respiratory infections not attributed to any of the three monitored pathogens? 1 means usual for the time of year.

cyber.services.statuspage_disruption_sha.name: Share of providers with any disruption
cyber.services.statuspage_disruption_sha.plain: What percentage of the observed providers are currently reporting any disruption, even a minor one.

cyber.finance.statuspage_payment_disrupt.name: Payment services with a disruption
cyber.finance.statuspage_payment_disrupt.plain: What percentage of the observed payment services (Braintree, Mollie, Square and others) are currently reporting a disruption.

cyber.services.statuspage_cloud_disrupti.name: Cloud and CDN providers with a disruption
cyber.services.statuspage_cloud_disrupti.plain: What percentage of the observed cloud and CDN providers (Cloudflare, Fastly, DigitalOcean and others) are currently reporting a disruption. A CDN is a network that delivers websites faster.

cyber.services.statuspage_incident_start.name: New disruptions per day (8 lead providers)
cyber.services.statuspage_incident_start.plain: How many new disruptions (minor to critical) the eight major cloud, payment and developer services reported yesterday.

cyber.services.statuspage_major_starts_d.name: New severe disruptions per day (8 lead providers)
cyber.services.statuspage_major_starts_d.plain: How many new severe (major/critical) disruptions the eight major cloud, payment and developer services reported yesterday.

cyber.outages.tor_advertised_bandwidth.name: Tor relay bandwidth
cyber.outages.tor_advertised_bandwidth.plain: Total capacity that all Tor relays advertise; a drop shows problems in the Tor network.

cyber.outages.tor_exit_nodes.name: Tor exit nodes (IPv4)
cyber.outages.tor_exit_nodes.plain: How many exit nodes the Tor network currently has; a drop shows interference or disruptions in the Tor network.

cyber.threat.tweetfeed_iocs_daily.name: TweetFeed: reported IOCs per day
cyber.threat.tweetfeed_iocs_daily.plain: How many phishing addresses, malware servers and file fingerprints (IOCs, indicators of compromise) security researchers publicly report per day.

cyber.threat.tweetfeed_malware_iocs_dail.name: TweetFeed: malware, C2 and ransomware reports per day
cyber.threat.tweetfeed_malware_iocs_dail.plain: How many of the daily reports concern malware, control servers (C2), ransomware or state-backed hackers.

nuclear.seismic.nuclear_explosion_type_g.name: Events classified as nuclear explosions worldwide
nuclear.seismic.nuclear_explosion_type_g.plain: Number of events in the last 24 hours that the USGS catalog classifies as a nuclear explosion; normally zero.

cyber.attention.wikipedia_de.name: Wikipedia views on cyber topics (German)
cyber.attention.wikipedia_de.plain: How often German-language Wikipedia articles on hackers, ransomware, phishing and power outages are viewed.

cyber.attention.wikipedia_en.name: Wikipedia views on cyber topics (English)
cyber.attention.wikipedia_en.plain: How often English Wikipedia articles on cyberattacks, ransomware, phishing and data leaks are viewed.

war.attention.wikipedia_de.name: Wikipedia views on war topics (German)
war.attention.wikipedia_de.plain: How often German-language Wikipedia articles on World War III, nuclear war, mobilization, conscription or martial law are viewed.

war.attention.wikipedia_en.name: Wikipedia views on war topics (English)
war.attention.wikipedia_en.plain: How often English Wikipedia articles on World War III, nuclear war, conscription, martial law, Taiwan or the Strait of Hormuz are viewed.

cyber.markets.cyber_etf_abs_return.name: Daily swings of cyber ETFs
cyber.markets.cyber_etf_abs_return.plain: How much cybersecurity ETFs rise or fall in one day (absolute value of the daily return).

cyber.markets.vix.name: VIX (fear index of the US stock market)
cyber.markets.vix.plain: How nervous the US stock market is overall; it rises in any kind of crisis.

cyber.markets.gold_abs_return.name: Daily swings of the gold price
cyber.markets.gold_abs_return.plain: How much the gold price jumps in one day, a classic sign of flight movements.

cyber.markets.btc_abs_return.name: Daily swings of Bitcoin
cyber.markets.btc_abs_return.plain: How much Bitcoin jumps in one day; Bitcoin depends on the network and reacts to outages and risk aversion.

war.markets.brent_futures.name: Brent futures (exchange price)
war.markets.brent_futures.plain: The price of North Sea crude oil (Brent); fear of war in producing regions pushes it up.

war.markets.wti_futures.name: WTI futures (exchange price)
war.markets.wti_futures.plain: The price of US crude oil (WTI); it follows the Brent price and reacts to risks in the Gulf.

war.markets.oil_volatility_ovx.name: Oil volatility (OVX)
war.markets.oil_volatility_ovx.plain: How strongly investors expect large swings in the oil price; it rises with worry about supply disruptions.

ai.markets.ai_stock_abs_return.name: Daily swings of AI chip stocks (NVDA, AMD, AVGO)
ai.markets.ai_stock_abs_return.plain: How much the shares of AI chip makers rise or fall in one day (absolute value of the daily return).
